scope: Strict success response and OpenAPI contract for the private location-scoped cooperative management summary.

route.validation: The projection is explicitly validated before returning JSONResponse, since FastAPI does not validate Response subclasses.

error_contract.authorization: existing 403 response and cache headers preserved
error_contract.disabled_oidc: existing 404 response and cache headers preserved
error_contract.invalid_input: existing 400 response and cache headers preserved
error_contract.database_failure: existing sanitized 503 response and Retry-After preserved
error_contract.invalid_projection: sanitized 500 with no-store and Vary: Cookie

limitations: This closes the private cooperative-summary response contract only; it does not establish live OIDC behavior, populated-data parity, or broader Gateway authorization parity.
